title: Nvidia eyes major investment in Figure AI robotics: Here’s what to know
source_used: The News International (no original reporter named in the article)
key_facts: Nvidia has been in talks to invest another $1 billion in Figure AI, a humanoid robot startup founded by Brett Adcock in 2022.
Nvidia joined Figure's funding round in September 2025, when the round raised over $1 billion at a post-money valuation of $39 billion.
Nvidia is a technology provider for Figure's Helix AI models and robot deployments; Jensen Huang calls the setup a 'robotics flywheel'.
Figure has said its main limits are a shortage of training data and too little computing power.
The article gives no original reporter or source for the new talks.
quote_evidence: In a significant move, Nvidia has been in talks to invest another $1 billion in Figure AI, the humanoid robotics startup founded by Brett Adcock in 2022.
Nvidia’s primary role goes beyond writing checks as the chipmaker is a technology provider for Figure’s Helix AI models and robot deployments.
why_it_matters_hint: A chip maker going deeper into a humanoid robot startup shows how much computing money robot builders need.
event_date: Reported 7 Oct 2026; date of the talks not stated
notes: Chain unclear: the article names no first reporter. The round and valuation figures come from the article and were not checked.
